description: Kerala minister P K Kunhalikutty said laws and governance systems must adapt to rapid AI advances, while a new C-DIT AI Lab will develop reusable, Malayalam-focused public AI services under government control.
body_lead: Governance systems and laws must change in tune with rapid technological developments in the artificial intelligence era to support young people and startups coming up with new ideas, Kerala minister P K Kunhalikutty said on Thursday. Speaking after inaugurating the new ICT Complex, AI Lab and Security Lab of the Centre for Development of Imaging Technology (C-DIT) at Pattom here, the Industries, Commerce, IT and AI minister said the government must be ready to adapt to technological changes.
